What to require from supplier: Require complete orderable part and die revision; reject “sensor optional” quotations.
Confirm bare IC, sensor board, lens module, serializer camera, USB camera or full enclosure.
MIPI CSI-2, FPD-Link III, GMSL2 and USB are not interchangeable. Confirm lanes, rate, RAW bits and connector.
For SerDes cameras, confirm serializer IC and matching deserializer/fusion board.
Ask for uncompressed RAW Bayer. H.264/ISP-only modules may hide exposure/tone mapping.
Request exposure count, PWL curve, decompanding, motion artifacts and simultaneous LFM.
Confirm manual/auto exposure, gain, anti-flicker, sync, trigger and strobe.
Require HFOV/VFOV, focal length, f-number, distortion, MTF, focus, IR-cut and thermal shift.
Require intrinsics, distortion coefficients, alignment tolerance and EEPROM format.
Sensor AEC-Q100 does not make the module automotive-grade. Ask module validation.
Ask for safety manual, diagnostics, CRC/frame counter/error pin and FMEDA availability.
Ask lifecycle, LTB policy, annual capacity, origin and traceable lot/date codes.
Ask for target-SoC tuning/DCC files and custom lens tuning support.
Demand working driver/device tree/config for AXON, Jetson, Pi or TI TDA4.
Buy 2–5 identical samples and check identity, focus, hot pixels, hot operation and EMI.
Compare lens + camera + serializer + cable + deserializer + adapter + enclosure + support.
